diagnostic.title: No false self barge-in on Jarvis's own output
diagnostic.description: Jarvis speaks while its own output returns as input; no candidate may be confirmed as a barge-in. On hardware:auto the echo is a real room rather than a declared coupling.

parameters.name: output.duration_ms
parameters.description: How long Jarvis speaks in the scenario.

parameters.name: echo.candidate_count
parameters.description: Echo barge-in candidates injected while the output plays.

parameters.name: echo.coupling_db
parameters.description: Acoustic coupling of the injected echo, in dB relative to what Jarvis played (audio profile).

parameters.name: device.input
parameters.description: Microphone id or name; empty means the workstation's configured device.

parameters.name: device.output
parameters.description: Output id or name; empty means the workstation's configured device.

metrics.name: barge_in.false_confirmed_count
metrics.description: Barge-ins confirmed while Jarvis spoke with no user activity in the window.

metrics.name: barge_in.rejected_count
metrics.description: Echo candidates the owner decision rejected.

metrics.name: output.completed
metrics.description: The scripted output reached its terminal status.

metrics.name: output.played_ms
metrics.description: Audio actually played before the output ended.

metrics.name: barge_in.first_candidate_offset_ms
metrics.description: Output already played when the first barge-in candidate was raised. The echo canceller keeps a 400 ms pre-roll, so a candidate before that would measure its convergence, not the gate.

assertions.description: Jarvis never interrupts itself on its own echo.
The output plays to its terminal status.
